// observability, reimagined

Display sample for JA Kinetic

Section heading at thirty-eight

Card title at twenty-three

A geometric sans carries display at weight 700 with tracking that tightens as it grows, from -0.3px at 19 to -1.5px at 52, while the humanist body runs at 1.55.

There is no serif in this system. The tension that makes it read as a developer tool is the negative tracking on the display face against the monospace eyebrow tracked a full +2px in the other direction.

The preview uses only schema tokens, so reviewers can confirm the package stays portable across OpenDesign artifacts.
